//ForwardProxies: Trust X-Forwarded-* from these proxies (KnownProxies: addresses; KnownNetworks: CIDRs, e.g. the OpenShift pod network the router pods live in).

Strapi.//BaseUrl: Content engine base URL. Set per environment; appsettings.Development.json points at http://localhost:1337.
Strapi.//AdminApiToken: Write-scoped Strapi API token granting find + findOne + create + update on form-spec (the admin form editor) and on eligibility-rate (the admin rates editor), and nothing else - never delete. Publishing with status=published needs no separate permission. The only Strapi token this API holds; the citizen API (MyssApi) keeps the read-only one. NEVER commit a real value - set it in appsettings.local.json for local dev, or as the env var Myss_Strapi__AdminApiToken in a container. Unset means admin writes fail loudly with a 403 rather than silently succeeding, and the rates editor reads the compiled table.

Oidc.//Audience: Expected 'aud'. Omit to default to ClientId - verified 2026-07-27 that a real IDIR token from this client carries aud == azp == the client id. Set to "" only for a realm that mints aud:'account', which disables audience validation and leaves the azp check as the sole guard.
Oidc.//RoleSource: Realm | Client | Both. Both is the safe default until IDIM confirms whether this realm carries roles in realm_access or resource_access.
